levels.name: First Sparks: Direct Cause & Effect
levels.description: Immediate tactile feedback connecting mouse click to audio & visual output. Zero math, zero frustration, 100% delight.

projects.title: Click to Meow
projects.blocks: when this sprite clicked, play sound Meow, say Hello!
projects.outcome: The quintessential first-touch coding lesson. Immediate tactile feedback connecting mouse click to audio & visual output.

projects.title: Color Morph Balloon
projects.blocks: when this sprite clicked, change color effect by 25, play sound Pop
projects.outcome: Vibrant visual transformation. Every tap shifts the balloon through the rainbow with an auditory pop.

projects.title: Grow and Shrink Cat
projects.blocks: when this sprite clicked, change size by 20, wait 0.5, change size by -20
projects.outcome: Teaches reversible scale transformations and time delays (`wait`) in just 4 simple blocks.

projects.title: Roaring Lion
projects.blocks: when this sprite clicked, repeat 5 [change size by 10], play sound Roar
projects.outcome: Introduces the mini-repeat loop to create an explosive, roaring visual shockwave.

levels.name: Living Characters: Loops & Animation
levels.description: Teaching the computer to repeat actions automatically. Students learn costume flipping and forever loops.

projects.title: Spinning Monkey
projects.blocks: repeat 10 [turn right 36 degrees, wait 0.05]
projects.outcome: Unlocks circular geometry naturally: 10 repeats of 36 degrees yields a flawless full somersault.

projects.title: Flapping Bat
projects.blocks: forever [next costume, wait 0.2]
projects.outcome: Classic frame-by-frame cartoon animation. Transforms static sprites into flying, living creatures.

projects.title: Jumping Hare
projects.blocks: when space key pressed, change y by 60, wait 0.2, change y by -60
projects.outcome: First keyboard interactivity! Connects the spacebar to vertical y-axis jumping motion.

projects.title: Waving Scratch Cat
projects.blocks: when flag clicked, repeat 6 [switch costume, wait 0.2], meow audio
projects.outcome: A richer, multi-frame character welcome that feels like a polished television cartoon intro.

projects.title: Aquarium Fish Swim
projects.blocks: forever [move 3 steps, if on edge bounce, next costume]
projects.outcome: Multi-sprite ambient ecosystem. Creates a peaceful digital aquarium where independent sprites swim.

levels.name: Storytelling & Dialogue: Directing a Scene
levels.description: Connecting code to language and storytelling. Script character conversations and choreograph turn-taking.

projects.title: Say Hello to Scratch Cat
projects.blocks: say [Hello!] for 2 secs, say [Welcome to STEMulus!] for 2 secs
projects.outcome: Introduces narrative pacing and timed speech bubbles, turning code into written self-expression.

projects.title: The Knock Knock Joke
projects.blocks: Timed say and wait blocks alternating between two characters
projects.outcome: Teaches conversational rhythm. Sprites take turns so they never speak over each other.

projects.title: Two Friends Greeting
projects.blocks: Broadcast message or synchronized dialogue delays
projects.outcome: Simulates a genuine social interaction between two human characters meeting at school.

projects.title: Switch the Scene
projects.blocks: when space key pressed, next backdrop, play sound Cheer
projects.outcome: Teaches scene management. The student learns that changing backdrops transitions the story world.

projects.title: Meet Scratch and Abby
projects.blocks: Costume expressions, synchronized cues, musical intro
projects.outcome: A full theatrical skit demonstrating how professional digital storybooks and animations are directed.

levels.name: Interactive Toys & Clickers: User Input
levels.description: Connecting user input directly to game states with mouse tracking, coordinate hops, and rapid-response clickers.

projects.title: Slithering Snake
projects.blocks: forever [point towards mouse-pointer, move 4 steps]
projects.outcome: Instant kinetic feedback! The snake smoothly tracks the player's cursor across the canvas in real time.

projects.title: Pop the Balloon Blitz
projects.blocks: when this sprite clicked, change score by 1, go to random position, play Pop
projects.outcome: The world's purest complete game loop: User action -> Audio feedback -> Data increment -> State reset.

projects.title: Catch the Cat
projects.blocks: forever [wait 1 sec, go to random pos], when clicked [score + 1]
projects.outcome: Whack-a-mole mechanics. Tests reaction speed by pitting the player's reflexes against an automated timer.

projects.title: Whack-a-Monkey
projects.blocks: hide, wait pick random 1 to 3, go to random pos, show, wait 1, hide
projects.outcome: Introduces controlled chaos using `pick random () to ()` to make game difficulty unpredictable and exciting.

levels.name: First True Games: Variables & Catchers
levels.description: Transforming toys into full games with clear win/loss conditions, variables (Score, Lives, Timer), and collision detection.

projects.title: Catch the Falling Apple
projects.blocks: Bowl: set x to mouse x; Apple: change y by -5, if touching Bowl score + 1
projects.outcome: The classic arcade catcher. Teaches separation of player paddle movement and automated object gravity.

projects.title: Balloon Pop Blitz (Core Edition)
projects.blocks: Multi-colored balloons floating up, timer countdown variable, combo scoring
projects.outcome: Elevates the junior clicker into an arcade sprint with a 30-second countdown timer and game over screen.

projects.title: Apple Catcher Basket
projects.blocks: Falling speed acceleration variable, miss detection (y < -160 loses life)
projects.outcome: Introduces progressive difficulty: as score increases, apple falling speed accelerates dynamically.

projects.title: Fruit Basket Catcher
projects.blocks: Multiple fruit types with costume switching and distinct score values
projects.outcome: Visual variety using built-in fruit sprites, rewarding students for catching rare bonus items.

levels.name: Avatar Controls & Mazes: 2D Coordinates
levels.description: True 2D player navigation with 4-directional arrow controls, maze boundaries, and obstacle avoidance.

projects.title: Simple Arrow Maze
projects.blocks: 4 arrow key scripts (change x/y), if touching wall color bounce back
projects.outcome: The ideal beginner maze: crystal clear 4-direction navigation and collision boundary logic without complexity.

projects.title: Mouse Maze Escape
projects.blocks: Continuous velocity sensing, wall reflection, cheese victory broadcast
projects.outcome: Smooth, lag-free maze engine with celebratory win fanfare when reaching the cheese goal.

projects.title: Frog Pond Hop
projects.blocks: Hop distance steps, boundary reset if falling into deep water
projects.outcome: Grid-based discrete hopping. Teaches safe zone vs. hazard zone state logic.

projects.title: Road Crossing Frogger Junior
projects.blocks: Autonomous traffic patrolling horizontally, timing player cross
projects.outcome: Teaches timing and pattern recognition as the student times their crossing between moving buses.

levels.name: Arcade Physics: Gravity, Jumpers & Pong
levels.description: Simulating real-world physical forces: gravity loops, angle reflection formulas for bouncing balls, and jump timing.

projects.title: Keep the Balloon Up
projects.blocks: Balloon y-drop, paddle upward impulse on touch, floor hazard
projects.outcome: A gentle first simulation of upward impulse and falling momentum that feels remarkably natural.

projects.title: Pong Solo Wall Bounce
projects.assets: Ball, Paddle, Red Line | Neon Tunnel
projects.blocks: point in direction (180 - direction), speed multiplier variable
projects.outcome: The cornerstone of video game history. Demystifies geometric angles and paddle deflection in under 20 blocks.

projects.title: Dino Desert Jump
projects.blocks: Cactus scrolls left, Dino jumps with y-velocity gravity loop
projects.outcome: Chrome Dino runner clone using 100% native assets! Pure arcade thrill requiring precise jumping reflexes.

projects.title: Space Asteroid Dodge
projects.blocks: Smooth ship steering, multi-speed tumbling asteroid rocks
projects.outcome: Thrilling space survival requiring students to balance evasive maneuvering with score bonuses.

projects.title: Fruit Salad Avoid Bombs
projects.blocks: Compound boolean conditions (if touching fruit vs. if touching bomb)
projects.outcome: Teaches logical operators (`and`, `or`, `not`) and risk-vs-reward gameplay decisions.

levels.name: Studio Masters: Clones, Platformers & 3D Runner
levels.description: The pinnacle of block-based programming: dynamic sprite cloning, authentic Mario-style platformer physics, and 3D pseudo-perspective.

projects.title: Snake Nibbler
projects.assets: Snake Head, Food Dot | Retro Grid
projects.blocks: Clone body segment trail following head, grid step loop, self-bite collision
projects.outcome: Classic retro Nokia Snake. Uses clone life timers to maintain a growing body trail behind the head.

projects.title: Brick Breaker Arcade
projects.blocks: Nested loop clone grid generator (4 rows x 6 cols), hit detection
projects.outcome: Demonstrates the power of cloning: a single brick sprite generates an entire colorful breakable wall!

projects.title: Space Invaders Defense
projects.blocks: Alien fleet marching & dropping, player laser projectile cloning
projects.outcome: Multi-clone interaction: clones detecting collisions with other clones, simulating classic 1978 arcade action.

projects.title: Platformer Hero Jump & Climb
projects.blocks: x-velocity + friction, y-velocity gravity, ground collision check
projects.outcome: The holy grail of Scratch coding! A responsive, authentic platformer engine with zero glitching.

projects.title: Subway Surfers 3D Track Runner
projects.assets: Runner Cat, Trains, Rails (100% Vector Built-in)
projects.blocks: 3-lane perspective scaling (distance z-factor), lane-switching jump & slide
projects.outcome: The master capstone project! Proves that Scratch can produce a fast-paced 3D runner using purely native assets.
